properties.name: kanbancord.internal-sync.bot-token
properties.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the raw shared secret used by the Discord bot to call internal sync endpoints.

properties.name: kanbancord.auth.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing secret used by backend access tokens.

properties.name: kanbancord.auth.jwt.expiration-seconds
properties.description: Lifetime of backend access tokens in seconds.

properties.name: kanbancord.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed browser origins for REST API requests (CORS).

properties.name: kanbancord.realtime.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed browser origins for websocket upgrades.

properties.name: kanbancord.realtime.ticket-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Lifetime of one-time websocket handshake tickets in seconds.

properties.name: kanbancord.discord.api-base-url
properties.description: Discord API base URL used for identity lookup via /users/@me.

properties.name: kanbancord.discord.oauth.client-id
properties.description: Discord application client ID used for OAuth authorization code exchange.

properties.name: kanbancord.discord.oauth.client-secret
properties.description: Discord application client secret used for OAuth authorization code exchange.
